programs.title: Road absurdities 6
programs.desc: The presenters observe chaos at the newly rebuilt intersection in Olsztyn.They also check what effects a vertical marking in Łysonie and a tree in the street gauge in Praslity have on road users.Viewers will also see a pedestrian crossing leading into the forest, which operates in Olsztynek, an original roundabout in Elbląg, and bollards costing PLN 75,000 in Tuszewo.The authors also visit a strange roundabout in Oborniki Śląskie, which serves as a parking lot, stop and taxi rank.

programs.title: Road absurdities 6
programs.desc: In Polkowice, Kamil and Krzysiek will see sound-absorbing screens, and in Trzebnica, a pedestrian crossing that leads straight to the school's exit gate.They will check why Wrocław needs a large scaffolding for two small directional signs.They will also find out why there are two slow-down chicanes on one side of the street in Jaworzno.In Międzychód they will come across an overloaded bridge with a tonnage limit.In Borowiec, Krzysiek and Kamil will look for 150 meters of asphalt, and in Szczecin they will check the cost of not very practical canopies over ticket machines.Finally, they will go to Bytom and read the entry ban carefully.
